title: AffectedProductsRecord
description: Affected-product scope extracted from one security advisory or KEV entry. Every claim is tied to verbatim evidence from the source.

schema_version.description: Set by advisory-scope, not by the model.

cve_ids.description: CVE identifiers covered by this record, exactly as they appear in the source.

affected.description: One entry per distinct affected product or edition. Never list the same vendor+product twice.

not_affected.description: Products the source explicitly says are NOT affected. Unaffected release lines of an affected product belong in that product's ranges, not here.

extraction_notes.description: Ambiguities, gaps, or assumptions. Use this instead of guessing.

product.description: Product or edition name as written in the source, e.g. 'PAN-OS' or 'NetScaler ADC 13.1-FIPS'.

version_scheme.description: dotted: numeric vendor versions incl. hotfix/build suffixes (10.2.9-h1, 13.1-49.15). semver: strict MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. opaque: no reliable ordering; ranges must be empty.

ranges.description: Half-open affected ranges, one per release line.

versions.description: Explicitly enumerated affected versions not expressed as a range.

conditions.description: Configuration or deployment prerequisites for exposure stated in the source. Empty if none stated.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes (contiguous spans copied from the source) supporting this entry.

introduced.description: First affected version (inclusive). "0" means every earlier version.

fixed.description: First non-affected version (exclusive). Null if no fix is named.

last_affected.description: Last affected version (inclusive), used only when no fix is named. Never set together with fixed.

branch.description: Release line this range is confined to (e.g. "12.1" for an end-of-life line where every build is affected). Null if the bounds alone are enough.
